_about: Official race facts typed from official announcements (IRONMAN, 70.3 and T100 publish no API). The weekend job adds each race when it is within the next 10 days, marked confirmed. Fields as in news.json races[]: series (IRONMAN | 70.3 | T100 | WTCS), name, date, place, tz (IANA), starts {women, men} as ISO times with offset, official_url, tracking {name, url}, watch {name, url}, points. Leave a field out when it is not announced.
